login.title: Sign in to Argos APM
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.setupHint: First start of this server? Create the administrator account.

error.invalid: The user name or password is incorrect.
error.locked: This account is locked after repeated failed sign-ins. Try again in 15 minutes or later, or ask an administrator to unlock it.
error.lockedFor_one: This account is locked after repeated failed sign-ins. Try again in {{count}} minute, or ask an administrator to unlock it.
error.lockedFor_other: This account is locked after repeated failed sign-ins. Try again in {{count}} minutes, or ask an administrator to unlock it.
error.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
error.rateLimitedNoWait: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.network: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.server: Signing in failed on the server (request ID {{requestId}}). Try again later.
error.serverNoId: Signing in failed on the server. Try again later.
error.required: Enter the user name and the password.
error.sessionNotKept: The user name and password were accepted, but the browser did not keep the session cookie, so you are not signed in. Open Argos over HTTPS, or at localhost on the server itself or through an SSH tunnel; the installation guide explains how ("Choose the address of the UI").

forcedChange.title: Change your password
forcedChange.description: Your password was set by an administrator or by the installer. Choose a new password before you continue.

password.changed: The password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
password.policy: Use 12 to 128 characters. Common passwords, your user name and the word "argos" are not accepted.

error.tooShort: The new password needs at least 12 characters.
error.tooLong: The new password can have at most 128 characters.
error.denylisted: This password is too common. Choose another one.
error.containsUsername: The password must not contain your user name.
error.containsProductName: The password must not contain the word "argos".
error.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one.
error.locked: The account is locked after repeated failures. Try again later.
error.failed: The password could not be changed (request ID {{requestId}}). Try again.
error.failedNoId: The password could not be changed. Try again.

setup.title: Set up Argos APM
setup.notFoundDescription: An administrator exists, so the setup wizard is closed. Sign in with an existing account.
setup.statusFailed: The setup status could not be read. Check that the server is running and reload the page.

token.description: Enter the one-time setup token. When the server started, it wrote the token to its log and to the setup-token file in its data directory; the installation guide shows how to read it. It is valid for 30 minutes; restart the server to get a new one.
token.label: Setup token

ipMode.description: Choose how Argos stores the client IP addresses of monitored requests. You can change it per application later; agents may only reduce it.
ipMode.fullHelp: Stores the complete client address. Collect it only if you have a legal basis for processing personal data.
ipMode.maskedHelp: Stores the network part only: the last IPv4 octet and the lower 80 bits of IPv6 become 0 (203.0.113.0).
ipMode.offHelp: Stores no client address (0.0.0.0). IP-based search and filtering are then not possible.

error.token: The setup token is wrong, expired or already used. Check the server log, or restart the server for a new token.
error.closed: Setup is already complete. Sign in with an existing account.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
error.rateLimitedNoWait: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.failed: The administrator could not be created (request ID {{requestId}}). Try again.
error.failedNoId: The administrator could not be created. Try again.

firstApp.description: Optionally register your first Java application and issue its agent token now. You can skip this step and create tokens later with the token create command of the argos-compose.sh script.
firstApp.name: Application name
firstApp.envHint: The agent's app.env, for example prod or staging: 1 to 32 characters.
firstApp.tokenOnce: This token is shown only now and never again. Copy it and store it before you continue.
firstApp.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Select the token and copy it.
firstApp.store: Write the token into a file that only the application's user can read, for example /opt/argos-agent/token with mode 0600. Do not put the token on a command line.
firstApp.attachTitle: Start the application with the agent
firstApp.attach: Add these JVM options to the start command of the application. The collector address is this server on port 9100; if the collector uses a certificate of your own certificate authority, the installation guide lists the TLS options.

error.nameRequired: Enter the application name: 1 to 128 characters, no control characters.
error.envRequired: Enter the environment: 1 to 32 characters, no control characters.
error.exists: An application with this name and environment exists. Choose another name or environment, or skip this step.
error.invalid: The server did not accept the name or the environment. Check them and try again.
error.tokenFailed: The application is registered, but the token could not be issued (request ID {{requestId}}). Issue it again, or skip this step and use the token create command later.
error.tokenFailedNoId: The application is registered, but the token could not be issued. Issue it again, or skip this step and use the token create command later.
error.failed: The application could not be registered (request ID {{requestId}}). Try again or skip this step.
error.failedNoId: The application could not be registered. Try again or skip this step.

finish.title: Argos APM is ready
finish.description: The administrator account is created and you are signed in.
finish.sessionNotKept: The administrator account is created, but the browser did not keep the session cookie, so you are not signed in. Open Argos over HTTPS, or at localhost on the server itself or through an SSH tunnel, and sign in there; the installation guide explains how ("Choose the address of the UI").
finish.agentToken: Create an agent token for your application with the token create command of the argos-compose.sh script on the server host. The installation guide lists its options.
finish.agentTokenIssued: Store the agent token of your first application and start the application with the JVM options of the previous step. Create further tokens with the token create command of the argos-compose.sh script; the installation guide lists its options.
finish.agentAttach: Start the application with the Argos agent (-javaagent) and the token. The application is listed in the Application selector at the top of the page as soon as its token exists; the installation guide shows how to check that its agent is connected.

account.title: My account
account.languageDescription: The language of the user interface in this browser.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.description: Browsers that are signed in with your account, most recently used first. End a session you do not recognize: it is signed out at once.
sessions.currentHint: Sign out to end this session.
sessions.revokeFailed: The session could not be ended (request ID {{requestId}}). Try again.
sessions.revokeFailedNoId: The session could not be ended. Try again.
